full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in G.R. Case No.191 of 2010 corresponding to Golapgonj P.S. Case No.25 dated 26.06.2010 under section 143/447/341/ 323/324 /326/307/379/427/114 of the Penal Code, now pending in the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sylhet. 

 After investigation police submitted a charge sheet against the accused petitioner and others under section 143/447/341/ 323/ 324/326/307/379/427/114 of the Penal Code on 08.08.2010.
